skills.name: Missed engineer visits and broadband faults
skills.summary: The engineer never came, or the fault dragged on. Ofcom says your provider must pay you automatically. Tempo checks the credit arrives and complains only when it is late.
jobs: Read the "sorry we missed you" card and read back any date it is unsure of
Price the automatic compensation from Ofcom's published scheme
Wait for the provider's own credit when waiting is the better move, then complain once if it does not come
Phone the provider for you, within the mandate you signed, and refuse vouchers

skills.name: Flight delay compensation (UK261)
skills.summary: Your flight landed hours late. UK261 pays a fixed amount by distance. Tempo works out the band and the exceptions, and claims it with your yes.
jobs: Work out the UK261 band from the route distance and the arrival delay
Flag extraordinary circumstances the airline may rely on, so you are not surprised
Ask you once, file the claim, and watch the six-year clock

skills.name: Delay Repay for UK trains
skills.summary: Your train was late. Tempo finds how late from rail data, works out what the operator owes you from its published bands, and claims it once you say yes.
jobs: Find out how late your train really was from National Rail and Realtime Trains data
Work out what you are owed from the operator's own Delay Repay bands, with the source shown
Have three AI jurors check the reading; they can say no, never change the amount
Ask you once in plain words, file the claim, and wait until the money has arrived

skills.name: Entitlement Check
skills.summary: Ten questions, then what is worth claiming: Pension Credit, Attendance Allowance and broadband social tariffs, with a pre-filled pack. Screening, not a decision.
jobs: Ask ten plain questions about age, income, savings and health
Say which benefits look worth claiming and roughly what they are worth each week
Prepare a pre-filled pack and point to the official page for each one

skills.name: Letter Explainer and Decision Challenger
skills.summary: Show Tempo any official letter and it reads it to you in plain words: what it is, what it says, who owes what, what to do by when, and the clocks it starts. A PIP decision is explained against its points, with a draft reply that adds no facts you did not give.
jobs: Read a photo of a bill, reminder or decision letter and say what it is and what it says
Say whether money is owed to you or by you, what you must do and by when
Read back anything it is not sure of as one plain question before trusting it
Name the rights clocks the letter starts, with the date each one ends
Explain a PIP decision against its points and work out the deadline from bank holidays
Draft a reply from your own words only, for you to check and send
skills.notes: photos are read once and never stored; in replay mode two synthetic letters are the demo

skills.name: Rights Decay: when to act
skills.summary: Every right has a clock, and some problems fix themselves. Tempo prices waiting against acting from real data and names the day to act, so nothing expires and no time is wasted.
jobs: Keep a clock for every right you hold, each with the rule it comes from
Work out, from how often cases like yours are paid without a fight, whether to wait or act today
Name the next decision date and wake up on it, even after a restart
Explain why it waited, in plain words, with the odds and the deadline

skills.name: Scam Shield
skills.summary: Tempo watches the texts that reach your phone and speaks when one is a trick. It checks the words, the links, the official registers and public phishing lists, and it never says "safe". It never moves your money.
jobs: Watch incoming texts on your phone and say out loud, in your language, when one is a trick
Hold a doubtful link, look behind it from the Gateway, and then tell you what was found
Check who the firm really is against Companies House, the FCA Register and the FCA Warning List
Check a message you forward by SMS, read out on the phone line, or paste on the web
Before you pay someone new, ask who, how much and why, then say pay, wait or stop
Keep a log of what it checked, never a word of the message, and learn only from what you give it
skills.notes: Recorded register, phishing-list and sandbox answers are used until keys are set and TEMPO_MODE=live. The text model is trained on two CC BY 4.0 SMS corpora plus a declared synthetic set; its numbers are in docs/scam_backtest.md. The Android node is written but not compiled here.
